Nabagsakan ang isang 22-anyos na babae ng malaking punong tumumba gabi nitong October 3, 2025 sa Espinosa Street, sa harap ng gusali ng Department of Budget and Management sa San Miguel, Manila.

Sa inisyal na ulat ng mga rumespondeng awtoridad, nakitaan ng posibleng bali sa kanang binti ang biktima. Agad siyang nilapatan ng paunang lunas at dinala sa pinakamalapit na ospital.

Pinutol-putol na ng Operations Team ng Manila DRRMO at ng Bureau of Fire Protection ang natumbang puno para maialis sa pagkakahambalang sa kalsada.

Courtesy: Manila DRRM Office/Facebook

data.raw_text:
Filipino teachers walked out of their classrooms and marched under the rain to commemorate World Teachers' Day with a call for urgent reforms in the education sector and accountability over the ongoing corruption scandal involving flood control projects.

Armed with umbrellas and raincoats, teachers trooped to Mendiola in Manila City while similar protest actions were held across the country. They also renewed their long-standing call for a higher education budget and decent wages.

Read more: https://t.co/FVgHXpoymP

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 7 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: TROPICAL CYCLONE "PAOLO"
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 04 October 2025(Saturday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Bataan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales, Tarlac and Pampanga.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Bulacan, Metro Manila, Rizal, Batangas(Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balayan, Bauan, Calaca, Calatagan, Tanauan, Laurel, Lemery, Lian, Mabini, Nasugbu, San Luis, San Nicolas, Santa Teresita, Taal, Talisay, Tingloy, Tuy), Laguna(Cabuyao, Calamba, Santa Rosa, Binan, San Pedro) and Quezon(General Nakar) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija and Cavite(Tanza, Naic) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
